```{.tikz}
\begin{tabular}{c}
\begin{tikzpicture}[fermion/.style={
      postaction={
        decorate,
        decoration={
          markings,
          mark=at position 0.275 with {\arrow[scale=1.5]{Stealth[]}},
          mark=at position 0.775 with {\arrow[scale=1.5]{Stealth[]}}
        }
      }
    },
        photon/.style={decorate, decoration={snake, amplitude=3pt, segment length=8pt}},
        very thick
    ]
        \def\R{1}
        \def\r{0.1}
        \coordinate (A) at (0,0);
        \coordinate (B) at (2,0);
        % Left fermion loop
        \draw[fermion] ($(A)+(-\R,0)$) circle (\R);
        % Right fermion loop
        \draw[fermion] ($(B)+(\R,0)$) circle (\R);
        % Wiggly photon connecting the two loops
        \draw[photon] (A) -- (B) node[midway, above, yshift=2pt] {\footnotesize Hartree};

        \draw[fill=white] (A) circle (\r);
        \draw[fill=white] (B) circle (\r);

    \end{tikzpicture}
\\[1em]
\begin{tikzpicture}[fermion/.style={
      postaction={
        decorate,
        decoration={
          markings,
          mark=at position 0.265 with {\arrow[scale=1.5]{Stealth[]}},
          mark=at position 0.765 with {\arrow[scale=1.5]{Stealth[]}}
        }
      }
    },
        photon/.style={decorate, decoration={snake, amplitude=3pt, segment length=8pt}}, very thick
    ]
        \def\R{1.5}
        \def\r{0.1}
        % Single fermion loop
        \draw[fermion] (0,0) circle (\R);

        % Two attachment points on loop
        \coordinate (A) at (\R, 0);
        \coordinate (B) at (-\R, 0);

        % Photon wiggly between A and B
        \draw[photon] (A) -- (B) node[midway, below, yshift=-2pt] {\footnotesize Fock};

        % Fermion arrowheads at A and B (to show direction locally)
        \draw[fill=white] (A) circle (\r);
        \draw[fill=white] (B) circle (\r);

    \end{tikzpicture}
\end{tabular}
```
